PERFECT FIT · SECTION 1 OF 6
Isosceles Triangle
Exactly 2 equal sides.
Two sides are 8 m and one is 6 m.

line: Choose an equilateral triangle.

line: Glowing sides are equal. Which frame has all three?
spoken: Glowing sides are equal. Which frame has all three?

line:
SPOT ON · SECTION 2 OF 6
Equilateral Triangle
All 3 sides are equal.
All 3 sides of this frame are 12 m.
spoken: Spot on! Section two of six. Equilateral Triangle. All three sides are equal. All three sides of this frame are twelve metres.

line: Choose a triangle where all 3 sides have different lengths.

line: Glowing sides are equal. Pick the frame with none.

WELL DONE · SECTION 3 OF 6
Scalene Triangle
All 3 sides are different.
Its sides are 6 m, 9 m and 10 m. None match.
spoken: Well done! Section three of six. Scalene Triangle. All three sides are different. Its sides are six metres, nine metres and ten metres. None match.

line:
GREAT READING · SECTION 4 OF 6
Acute Triangle
All 3 angles are less than 90°.
Its angles are 49°, 52° and 79°.
spoken: Great reading! Section four of six. Acute Triangle. All three angles are less than ninety degrees. Its angles are forty-nine degrees, fifty-two degrees and seventy-nine degrees.

EXACTLY RIGHT · SECTION 5 OF 6
Right Triangle

spoken: The largest angle of each frame is lit. Which is over ninety degrees?

Obtuse Triangle

Its largest angle is 134°.
